name: Angela
source:
One of the indigenous "Usagi Tenshi" of the Moon. She has a gentle and inclusive personality, but she is also clumsy.

After falling from the goddess, she was saved by Hakase. She is in love with him.

"I'm still an angel!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
